title: setaria excurrens
intro: Setaria excurrens, commonly known as African finger grass, is a type of annual grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Setaria excurrens include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Setaria excurrens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
